profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer offering strong skills in software design strategies and object-oriented language development on a variety of platforms, with an emphasis on hardware interfacing and control.  Project background includes 25+ years of extensive software design and development using .NET technologies such as C#, WPF and C++.
Other strengths include leadership, problem solving, interpersonal communication skills, and a broad exposure to complex domains in various industries.

Specialties: 
Software development tools: .NET, C#, WPF/XAML, C++, Python, Boost, Xamarin, SQL, XML, RabbitMQ/MessageBus, Google Protocol Buffers, AvaloniaUI, Visual Studio
Skills: 
-Extensive software architecture experience using object oriented/componentized design
-Strong multi-threaded design skills
-Mobile development for both iOS and Android
-Machine automation/control
-Machine vision/image processing

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
■ Key contributor in Abbott's capital equipment R&D organization for products focused on the treatment of Atrial Fibrillation.
■ Architected and designed C#/WPF application for data acquisition and visualization of several Abbott products.  This tooling software started as a simple R&D bench tool and evolved into an advanced platform used by many different groups in many different locations for a range of things such as: manufacturing, formal and informal testing, clinical research and product development.  
■ Created a python scripting API which interfaces with primary software/hw tools allowing a user to script out any behavior using the tool's data and hw-control capabilities.  This provides infinite capabilities for data manipulation, research, and testing.
■ C++ development for embedded WRL applications running on ARM processors with the purpose of handling high frequency data messaging, command/response processing, general hardware initialization and management.  Code base includes a thorough set of unit tests with mock simulations for HW allowing the testing and debugging of a majority of source code without any need of hardware resources.
■ Development of messaging architecture using the RabbitMQ message bus framework along with Google protocol buffers.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · C# · Python (Programming Language) · WPF

positions.title: Creator of mobile app "Rob Has a Podcast"
positions.description:
Creator of a multi-platform, mobile podcast player specifically targeted towards "Rob Has A Podcast". 
Provided on both Apple-iOS and Android platforms.
Developed entirely in C# using the Xamarin toolchain.
15000+ cumulative downloads.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
■ Develop and maintained system software for high-speed semiconductor strip test handlers.  Software was based on an MFC C++ platform.  Strip test equipment has numerous facets of software control: up to 13 axes of motion, multiple cameras used for machine vision (2D bar code reading, vision alignment, etc.), up to 7 zones of temperature control using a proprietary PID algorithm, and more than 50 digital inputs/outputs.
■ Led major development effort to componentize legacy software into re-usable pieces and re-write in C# to take advantage of newer .NET technologies.   Components interface with legacy C++ applications using the .NET COM-Interop features.
■ Architect and developer for new, state-of-the-art, automated laser-mark system based entirely on a C# platform that interfaces with several different hardware components such as: motion control, digital I/O, machine vision, and laser processing.  Application makes use of previously componentized software packages developed for other strip-test handlers, providing faster development cycles ultimately leading to fast time-to-market releases.  Software package is developed behind an advanced user interface which provides extensive system setup and control options, including a fully rendered 3D model of the system which updates real time, designed using OpenGL/C#. 
■ Extensive travel to customer sites in southeast Asia for deployment of new systems and software.
■ Developed and maintained daily build engine executed using MSBUILD scripting technology.
■ Deployed and maintained bug track system using open source web application Bug Tracker.

positions.title: Sr. Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
■ Developed real-time firmware for Disk-Drive interfacing protocols such as:  Fibre Channel, SAS (Serial-Attached SCSI), SATA (Serial ATA).  Firmware is run on an ARM processor.
■ Designed test scripts implemented with Perl and software, designed with C# .NET, to interact and control traffic generation hardware.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
■ Software architect for 18-axis automated optical measurement system integrating motion control, machine vision, digital signal analysis, and GPIB controlled optical measurement equipment.   The software was based on a multi-threaded architecture and designed using Visual C++ 6.0 on a Windows NT platform.
■ Traveled to customer sites during preliminary specification and design phases meeting with clients to discuss design strategies and product requirements.  At the end of development, further meetings were required for debugging and integration into customer factory sites.
■ Designed and developed a “drop-in” measurement library interface allowing customers to write their own measurement and analysis software while keeping both their technology and data proprietary.
■ Software design included multiple graphical user interface utilities in C++/MFC, as well as, DLLs for various utilities and system components using COM technology.
■ Developed an image processing library based on a Matrox machine vision system (blob analysis, edge detection, OCR, pattern matching).

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
■ Lead software engineer for automated system used to electrically test and sort disk-drive recording heads.  Worked closely with manufacturing, as well as, process engineers to continually improve system yield and thoughput.
■ Designed and developed both hardware and software for high-speed, small-signal data acquisition electronics. Hardware was implemented using Altera FPGAs and controlled via GPIB circuitry.
■ Developed firmware for Altera FPGA in VHDL, and low-level drivers in C/C++.
■ Texas Instruments DSP development with TMS320C3X series hardware and C compiler for low-level data acquisition and hardware control
■ Developed an image processing library based on a Cognex machine vision system (blob analysis, edge detection, OCR, pattern matching).
■ Supported tools in overseas mass-production facilities.
positions.insights: Skills: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) · Visual C++
